content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] notify-proxy -> outbound paging error spike for service="realtime-ingest". Observed 5xx/429s from pager provider; pages may be delayed. incident_id=INC-20250315-41

Sam C: seeing same. send_fanout queue length climbing on notify-proxy, lots of items stuck in OUTBOUND queue. provider returning 429 Retry-After: 60s

Irene: are oncall pages getting through? PagerBot shows partial acks but many failures. I've manually rung the current rotation. :phone:

PagerBot: OUTBOUND_SUMMARY: target=rotation-realtime-ingest sent=12 success=8 failed=4 errors=[429, 503]. provider_batch_endpoint hit rate limit. trace=pb-9a3f

Devon: manual escalation started. Sam, can you trigger fallback to sms-relay-v2 and also run a one-off page to the escalation list?

Sam C: running fallback now. command:
```
/ops page --fallback=sms-v2 --service=realtime-ingest --reason="provider-throttle"
```

Sam C: ok sms-relay-v2 accepted fanout, paging now showing successes. oncall confirmed receipt :white_check_mark:

Maria: Customer impact: 2 support tickets opened (#2217, #2218) citing delayed alerts. Estimated delay window ~8-12 minutes for affected batches. Not seeing wider customer alert drop yet.

Irene: preliminary root cause: recent fanout-throttle change in incident-bot (PR #834) lowered default concurrency 20->5. Combined with provider burst limits it pushed a bunch of pages into retries/backoff and the provider started returning 429s. logs snippet:
```
WARN fanout: concurrency_limit=5 queue_len=312 dispatch_errors=94 last_err=429
```

Sam C: plan: revert PR #834 (restore concurrency), add jittered backoff + exponential retries for 429s, and add metric alert for provider_429_rate > 1% for 5m. Also add auto-fallback to sms-v2 after N consecutive failures. Who will own the postmortem?

Devon: I'll own the postmortem and draft action items. Will include timeline + customer impact. Also adding an automation task: if outbound_failure_count > 3 in 2m, auto-trigger fallback and page ops channel. /cc @oncall-svc

incident-bot: MITIGATION: temporary rollback applied, notify-proxy concurrency bumped. paging success_rate back to 99% over last 5m. Monitoring alerts suppressed until stability confirmed.

Irene: thanks folks. Follow-ups: (1) Devon postmortem, (2) Sam deploy hotfix + revert, (3) Maria notify Support for affected customers + run comms template.

Sam C: I'm pushing the revert now. will update when fully deployed. :eyes:
